name: step3_favorcli_annotation
title: Experimental FAVOR-CLI Annotation Skeleton
summary: Experimental scaffolding for a future FAVOR-CLI-backed Step 3 annotation boundary.
description: Extracts canonical variant identity tables from chromosome-level GDS or VCF inputs and provides a dry-run boundary for future FAVOR-CLI integration. This applet does not inject annotations into GDS and is not a replacement for legacy FAVORannotator.

inputSpec.name: gds_file
inputSpec.label: Chromosome-level GDS file
inputSpec.help: Chromosome-level GDS input used for variant identity extraction.

inputSpec.name: vcf_file
inputSpec.label: Chromosome-level VCF or VCF.GZ file
inputSpec.help: Optional VCF/VCF.GZ input for the scaffold boundary.

inputSpec.name: favor_database_file
inputSpec.label: FAVOR database file
inputSpec.help: Optional FAVOR database artifact for future FAVOR-CLI invocation.

inputSpec.name: favor_cli_path
inputSpec.label: FAVOR-CLI executable path
inputSpec.help: Executable name or path for FAVOR-CLI when it becomes available.

inputSpec.name: favor_database_version
inputSpec.label: FAVOR database version
inputSpec.help: Documented FAVOR database version used for provenance.

inputSpec.name: reference_genome_build
inputSpec.label: Reference genome build
inputSpec.help: Reference genome build used to interpret variant identities.

inputSpec.name: threads
inputSpec.label: Thread count
inputSpec.help: Number of worker threads to reserve for future FAVOR-CLI use.

inputSpec.name: memory_budget_gb
inputSpec.label: Memory budget (GB)
inputSpec.help: Declared memory budget for future FAVOR-CLI runs.

inputSpec.name: output_dir
inputSpec.label: Output directory
inputSpec.help: Directory used for intermediate tables, validation reports, and raw-output placeholders.

inputSpec.name: dry_run
inputSpec.label: Dry-run mode
inputSpec.help: Validate configuration and extract variant identity without invoking FAVOR-CLI.

outputSpec.name: validation_report
outputSpec.label: Validation report
outputSpec.help: Validation summary for dry-run and scaffold execution.
